verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring runs is a fair question for an infrastructure automation tool, but the evidence documents no scheduling feature. What it does show are one-off executions: `apply -auto-approve`, saved plans, and MCP workspace "run management". Running these on a recurring basis would need an external scheduler such as CI or cron, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
